ai_summary: 360 ONE WAM Limited is implementing a significant strategic leadership restructuring, appointing veteran investment banker Aashish Agarwal as the new Group Chief Executive Officer, effective February 15, 2027. This proactive move aims to strengthen leadership, enhance focus across its wealth, asset, and capital markets verticals, and position the company for ambitious growth in the expanding Indian economy. Current MD & CEO Karan Bhagat will transition to Vice-Chairman and Managing Director, focusing on overarching group strategy and key relationships, with no apparent red flags concerning this planned succession.
